d_and_a.source: UPS 10-K acc. 0001628280-26-008432, DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization (as returned by deskstack)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: revenue fell 2.6% in FY2025 (88,661 vs 91,070) amid volume glide-down; modest decline then recovery to ~GDP-plus growth by FY2029.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 8.87% (7,867/88,661); FY2023 10.0%, FY2024 9.3%; hold ~9% with cost savings offsetting pressure.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: ~21% US federal plus state taxes; FY2025 effective rate not pulled; 23% judgement.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 3,685/88,661 = 4.2%; below FY2023 5.7%; held at latest level.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US 10Y Treasury par 2026-11-06) + relevered beta ~1.0 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US 2026-02-16) = ~9.3% cost of equity; beta = Damodaran Air Transport cash-corrected unlevered 0.758 relevered at assumed D/E 0.4 (no share price available; assumption), 25% tax. Pre-tax cost of debt 5.29% (Damodaran Air Transport). Weights 71/29 gives ~7.8%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal US growth/inflation, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 24,127 (ltd_noncurrent 23,519 + debt_current 608) - cash 5,887; no short-term investments reported; acc. 0001628280-26-008432. Note: ltd_noncurrent concept includes capital leases, so may slightly overstate debt excl. leases.
